result.rationale: The diff shows `minimumTokenResponseSchema` with two computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. Zod schemas do not override Object.prototype.toString, so both evaluate to '[object Object]', collide, and the second overwrites the first. The schema effectively reduces to `{access_token: string}` with strip behavior, dropping expiry fields in credential-sync mode — and in Salesforce's CalendarService.ts, the parsed data is stored as the credential key, losing instance_url. Mechanism verified from the diff.

judged_text: Both dynamic keys of minimumTokenResponseSchema call toString() on zod schema instances, which do not override Object.prototype.toString, so both keys evaluate to the same '[object Object]' string and the second declaration silently overwrites the first. The intended 'any numeric property is the expiry' catchall never applies and the schema reduces to {access_token: string} with strip-mode removing every other field — in sync mode expiry_date is dropped from every refreshed token (credentials keep their stale, already-expired expiry, forcing a refresh attempt on every use) and salesforce's stored key loses instance_url.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined as `z.object({ access_token: z.string(), [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), [z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional() })`. Those computed property names are just *literal* keys derived from calling `.toString()` on Zod schema objects; they do not create a “match any key”/catchall rule, and the two computed keys will collide if `.toString()` yields the same value (very plausible), causing one to overwrite the other. Additionally, since `z.object` defaults to `unknownKeys: 'strip'`, any real token fields like `expiry_date`, `instance_url`, etc. will be removed in this “minimum” sync-mode parse. This is consistent with the finding’s claim that expiry/extra fields would be dropped when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` triggers the minimum schema.
